Hannah (Sales): Warm pass for GroveBridge — 3-seat pilot signed today. Private VPC, Okta SSO, wants audit logs to their SIEM. Target cutover 2025-06-02.
Ravi (CS): Nice. Taking CS lead. Who's finance and infra on their side? Any blackout windows?
Hannah (Sales): Finance is finance@grovebridge.co, infra lead is jules@grovebridge.co. They prefer maintenance 01:00-05:00 UTC. Contract: https://redwood.app/contr/grove-777
Elena (Solutions): We'll need Okta metadata, redirect_uris, and syslog endpoint. Also confirm whether they want model auto-updates enabled for pilot (recommend OFF).
Min (Support): I'll own eng readiness and acceptance. Please open a triage ticket with expected qps, average token size, model family, and two sample payloads. Tag as P2 private-deploy.
Ravi (CS): Created ticket INF-3333 and added owners. handoff-bot: "Ticket INF-3333 created by Ravi (CS) — Onboarding: GroveBridge — owners: Ravi, Min, Elena"
handoff-bot: "Linked contract: https://redwood.app/contr/grove-777 (read-only)"
Hannah (Sales): They estimate 20k tokens/mo during pilot, prefer dedicated 2 GPU pool. Said they'll share Okta test tenant and sample payloads today.
Min (Support): For dedicated start recommend 1 x a10g-equivalent for pilot and run a short smoke test: `wrk -t4 -c50 -d60s /v1/chat` with ~130 token avg; also do a 3m soak at 40 concurrent. I'll post runbook in INF-3333.
Elena (Solutions): Sample config I asked them for:
```
issuer: https://gbridge.okta.com
client_id: 0oa1GROVEabc
redirect_uris:
  - https://app.grovebridge.co/_auth/okta/callback
syslog_url: syslog+tls://logs.grovebridge.co:6514
```
Ravi (CS): CS plan: 1) Kickoff + SSO + infra sync this week 2) Capture prompt library and acceptance prompts 3) Share early health snapshot at day 3 and weekly 4) Weekly sync until stable.
Min (Support): Ask to customer (INF-3333): provide two sample payloads (happy + edge), expected concurrent sessions, and a test Okta tenant admin.
Hannah (Sales): Will add Jules and finance contact to INF-3333 now.
Ravi (CS): Renewal flag: pilot auto-expands into annual if usage > 50k tokens/mo by month 3. We'll track tokens/day, p95 latency, and error rate as early indicators.
Min (Support): Note: enabling DEBUG logs will increase egress/storage — set a temporary cost cap alert. Also plan a pre-cutover spike test (5m @ 100 concurrent) if they confirm dedicated GPUs.
Ravi (CS): Owners recap: Ravi = CS lead, Min = support/eng, Elena = solutions/config, Hannah = sales follow-up. I'll schedule the kickoff and attach INF-3333. If anything blocks by Friday EOD, DM me. :white_check_mark:
